$comment: The empirical era checklist for the DOE `eforms-sdk-0.1` dialect (ADR-0002 amendment, ADR-0004). No SDK or public spec defines this format (docs/research/eforms-de-profile.md par.3), so the universe of mappable content is the full observed inventory: every element path in every sdk-0.1 notice of the sample history 2022-12..2026-07 (244,790 notice versions, scanned 2026-07-19 on the VPS; scan at /opt/tender-db/doe12/sdk01-scan.json, script sdk01_scan.py + sdk01_gen.py). Field ids are the source's own element names (SDK01- prefix, extension plumbing elided); types are derived from the source's naming conventions and observed listName attributes. A path outside this inventory quarantines the notice (unclaimed-content) - that is how the next dialect surprise surfaces. Extending the inventory is a reviewed edit of this file (re-run the scan over the new corpus, diff, decide each new path), then reprocess the quarantined notices from the archive. Full-corpus findings that correct the 800-file research sample (docs/research/eforms-de-profile.md par.3): 464 element paths, not 362; award amounts DO occur (PayableAmount/TotalAmount/Higher-LowerTenderAmount, with currencyID); multi-lot and Part-scheme lots occur in some months; dates/times may lack the zone offset (read as UTC, sdk-0.1 only - see eforms::value).
